measurementNotes.default: From the 1:1 technical drawing; values in mm.

gcd.placement: Right wing of the frame front (the wearer's right end-piece), centered on its flat front face where the two pin heads sit, clear of the lens bay's bevel inlay; the left wing keeps its pins (one GCD per frame)
gcd.faceSource: flat front face of the wing, measured from the 1:1 front view (drawing 03)
gcd.note: Same length as F04 and F05; leaves about 1 mm each side on the wing. How it is set over the hinge pins, and the final size, are for the factory (00-decisions.md O4).
